name: vscode-tree
//: VS Code's tree widget as a <vs-tree> custom element (README.md). monaco-editor is where the tree's code comes from; it is fetched by this lockfile and never checked in. playwright is pinned to the version datalib/ui's lockfile resolves, so the facts test finds the browser the e2e suite already installed.
